name: OpenVibe.Pics
description: OpenVibe.Pics is the picture host of the OpenVibe network, an open and ad-free alternative to Imgur: upload a picture and get a link to share or embed anywhere (the page, the direct link, Markdown, BBCode and HTML), with albums. Every picture is re-encoded with its GPS position and camera details removed, served unlisted (only people with the link see it), and anyone can report one; staff takedowns keep the same picture from coming back. Uploads need an OpenVibe account for now. AI image tools come next.

pillars.title: Upload & share
pillars.text: Drop, paste or choose pictures and get links to share and embed anywhere.

pillars.title: Albums

pillars.title: Clean files

pillars.title: Safe by default
pillars.text: Unlisted links, a report button on every picture, and takedowns that stay down.
